# Model Check

A **track** is one sequential line of work that one performer or station follows; steps within the same track must chain after each other and never overlap, so anything that happens in parallel belongs in a different track. A **step** has exactly one duration type: `fixed` (a known number of seconds), `variable` (a range with min, max, and planning default), or `indefinite` (runs until manually stopped). A **startTrigger** anchors a step to the clock or to another step's completion — `programStart` (t=0), `programStartOffset` (at a delay), `afterStep` (when a named step ends, optionally with an offset), `afterStepWithBuffer` (afterStep with a guaranteed gap), `manual` (user taps), `onAbort` (only if the referenced step is aborted), or `compound` (wait for all / the first of multiple triggers). **stepIds must be unique across the entire program**, not just within one track, so every step is globally addressable. Every `task` name that a step uses must have a matching `resourceConstraints` entry declaring `maxConcurrent` (e.g., one washer = `maxConcurrent: 1`, two incubators = `maxConcurrent: 2`), which the live runner enforces to prevent collisions. Repeated work — n plates, n samples, n aircraft — is declared as `replicates: {count: n, mode: "serial" | "parallel" | "stagger"}` on a single step, never as hand-copied steps or tracks; downstream steps chain per-instance with `instances: "each"` and converge with `instances: "all"`, and when a holding area (cooling rack, rotor, taxiway) only fits k items, `maxInFlight: k` on the replicates holds the upstream step instead of stranding the downstream one.

```json
{
  "acknowledgement": "tracks are sequential lines of work; one duration kind per step; triggers link steps; every task needs a resourceConstraint; stepIds are global",
  "resourceConstraints": [
    { "task": "washer", "maxConcurrent": 1 },
    { "task": "incubator_37C", "maxConcurrent": 2 },
    { "task": "reader", "maxConcurrent": 1 },
    { "task": "operator", "maxConcurrent": 1 }
  ],
  "actors": 1
}
```
